# HTTP API reference

Endpoints served by `ragkit serve`, generated from the FastAPI app. A running server also serves this as OpenAPI at `/openapi.json` and interactive docs at `/docs`.

When `auth.mode` is not `none`, send `Authorization: Bearer <API key or JWT>` (or `X-API-Key: <key>`). Missing or invalid credentials return 401, a missing scope 403, and an exceeded rate limit 429 with `Retry-After`.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/health` | Health |
| `GET` | `/ready` | Ready once agents are loaded and the store answers. |
| `GET` | `/agents` | List Agents |
| `POST` | `/agents/{name}/chat` | Chat |
| `POST` | `/agents/{name}/stream` | Stream |
| `POST` | `/agents/{name}/resume` | Resume |
| `POST` | `/agents/{name}/resume/stream` | Resume Stream |
| `GET` | `/collections` | List Collections |
| `POST` | `/collections/{name}/search` | Search |
| `POST` | `/collections/{name}/ingest` | Queue an ingestion job for `ragkit worker`; returns the (possibly merged) job. |
| `GET` | `/jobs` | List Jobs |
| `GET` | `/jobs/{job_id}` | Get Job |

**Response 200:** object

## `POST /agents/{name}/chat`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | True |

**Request body:** [`ChatRequest`](#chatrequest)

**Response 200:** [`ChatResponse`](#chatresponse)

## `POST /agents/{name}/stream`

| Parameter | In | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | True |

**Request body:** [`ChatRequest`](#chatrequest)

**Response:** `text/event-stream` with events `start`, `token` (`{"text"}`), then `approval_required` (`{"thread_id", "pending"}`) or `end`; failures after the stream starts arrive as `error`.
